analyst.summary: Park Medi World, North India's second-largest private hospital chain, posted a strong quarter with profit growing faster than revenue as the network matures. The company is expanding aggressively through both new bed capacity and two concurrent hospital acquisitions (V3 Healthcare/Medicity and Mehar Hospital), which should support continued growth but also add real integration work to manage at the same time. High promoter ownership is a positive alignment signal, and the stock's valuation already reflects the market's confidence in this expansion story.
